page.layout: One column of running text, with a marginal note at the right beside the last lines. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Signature "D 3" and catchword "præsule" at the foot.

main_text.p: ne nonnulli invito Episcopo usurparent, & traherent ad se, ab Imperatore soli Episcopo, & cui ille permitteret, est tributum, cum annus flueret à nato Christo D. CCCC. XLIV. Idem repetitum ac firmatum ab Henrico II, cui Claudi cognomen, in gratiam Aufridi, anno M. VI. Et ab eodem Comitatus ipse Drentiæ (sic loquuntur tabulæ) Ecclesiæ eidem in gratiam Adelboldi præsulis donatus in perpetuum: eoq; modo imperium regionis hujus in genere, uti ego existimo, juris Ultrajectini factum. Post mortuo Conra-do II. Imperatore, cujus ipsius quoq; animus Ultrajectinæ sedi ob episcopum Bernoldum & studio conjugis Giselæ impensè deditus fuerat, cum filius ejus Henricus III, cognomento Niger, intestina defuncti parentis in æde Martiniana ibidem condidisset, donationibus novis priores cumulavit: in quarum una est ea, quam dixi, Groningæ hujus nostræ memoria celebrata. Sic enim illic scriptum, Henricum Regem ecclesiæ Ultrajectinæ in ho-Diploma Henrici III Imp.norem Martini structæ, in remedium animæ patris, & sui memoriam perpetuam,

page.notes: The marginal note "Diploma Henrici III Imp." is set in three short lines beside "in ho-norem"..."perpetuam", transcribed as one note. The word before "Martini" may be an abbreviated "S." in italic; I have read it as "Martini" without the abbreviation, so this is uncertain. "I I" in "Conrado II." is set with a space in print; I have written it as "II.". The italic "Martini" and "structæ" may also contain small print damage. The catchword "præsule" is printed at the right foot, and "D 3" is the gathering signature. The page-edge shadow and the digitiser's watermark at lower right are excluded.
